theme: An open day, girls home in Florida.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan, with the girls home in Florida. An open stretch -- the only things pulling at it are a couple of travel bookings that have been waiting too long.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 in Todoist and 11 days past its book-this-week date. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the kids' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: Marked p1 and four days overdue. All four books are expired and December's trip depends on new ones landing in time, so the reschedule is the thing everything else waits on.

flagged.title: abebooks sign-in attempt
flagged.detail: A Sep 24 alert flags a sign-in from an iPhone near Florida -- likely you, but worth a glance to be sure.

flagged.title: IMC first-call questions circulating
flagged.detail: Chie Mitsui sent draft questions for the first Independent Managers Club conversation; addressed to Mike Lubrano with you cc'd, so nothing is owed from you yet.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions -- Bloomberg, Alison Roman, a LinkedIn job alert, and the usual retail.

resolved.title: Toronto panel -- you're moderating
resolved.detail: You accepted Elizabeth Thomas's invitation to moderate a panel at the ICGN event; her team is sending speaker logistics and setting up a pre-conference call.

recipe.title: Pheasant with Gin and It
recipe.why: Autumn is game season, when cooler evenings call for something braised and warming.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar to answer to -- the morning is entirely open.
Still no meetings booked; a clear stretch for the two items due today.
The girls are with you and Mike in Florida tonight.
